text:
maria-support: Acme reported a ~30s latency spike at 2026-03-16T14:12Z. They say the Console shows the request but no Request ID/trace attached. I asked for repro steps; wanted to confirm what to send them so we can escalate.

kevin-eng: Ok. Ask for three minimal things: exact timestamp (they gave), the raw request headers, and a curl repro (or HAR). If headers are missing probably a proxy is stripping X-Redwood-Request-ID. Request they run a curl with `-v` and include `-H 'X-Redwood-Debug: 1'` so we can see server-assigned id.

maria-support: Can you paste a sample curl we can send them? Also mobile SDK — they said they used our iOS SDK and didn't see the id in logs.

kevin-eng: Sure, give them this exact snippet (replace token):

`````
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Debug: 1" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"test"}'
`````

Explain: server will echo `X-Redwood-Request-Id` in response headers and `x-redwood-trace` if tracing is enabled. If they see nothing, ask for the raw `-v` output (copy the request/response header sections). Also ask for the `console` debug token if they've clicked "Create debug bundle" in the Console -> Request details.

tara-obs: For mobile: tell them to enable SDK verbose logging: iOS `Redwood.setLogLevel(.debug)` then reproduce. On Android `adb logcat | grep Redwood` will show `requestId=` lines. Also ask for the SDK version and the exact endpoint URL (some customers route through a proxy like `api.internal.company` — proxies often rewrite headers).

debug-bot: Reminder: if proxy rewrites `Authorization` or removes custom headers, they can set `Forwarded` or `X-Forwarded-*` to preserve. If their infra uses nginx, example config snippet:

`````
proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Request-Id $request_id;
proxy_pass_header X-Redwood-Request-Id;
`````

maria-support: Good. I'll send shortened checklist to Acme: timestamp, curl -v output, SDK logs + version, HAR or proxy logs, and Console debug bundle id if they created one.

kevin-eng: Also ask them to include one minimal request payload JSON sample so we can reproduce tokenization/latency pattern.

maria-support: Sent checklist to customer, they replied with curl output but redwood headers empty. Asked for HAR and proxy config. I'll update here when they reply.

kevin-eng: If they can't capture HAR, ask them to run `tcpdump -w capture.pcap host api.redwood.example` and send pcap (we can use it for header inspection). Only if they can share pcap securely.

maria-support: Noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

kevin-eng: If we get their proxy config, we can point to exact nginx/ELB fix. Otherwise we'll ask for a short live repro and attach a debug bundle for us to pull traces.

maria-support: Last note: if they created Console debug bundle, ask for the `debug_token` string (it's under the bundle confirmation) instead of screenshots — that token lets us pull full trace data.
